subject.title: feat(durable): add beta3 runtime core foundation

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this durable runtime as the canonical cross-owner recovery substrate, and should it replace or integrate with the existing task, subagent, audit, lease, flow, and delivery state owners?
rationale: This PR establishes a new persistent core runtime, public protocol and CLI surface, environment controls, and lifecycle semantics; code review cannot safely select that permanent architecture without maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor and consolidate
options.body: Approve the durable direction but require one shared-state migration owner, Kysely runtime access, narrower ownership boundaries, and complete live upgrade proof.

options.title: Extend existing owners
options.body: Decline the parallel runtime ledger and add the missing recovery facts to existing task, subagent, audit, lease, flow, and delivery stores.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Hold implementation review until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104246 is explicitly accepted and the dependent end-to-end slices are available.

recommendation.title: Sponsor and consolidate
recommendation.body: Approve the durable direction but require one shared-state migration owner, Kysely runtime access, narrower ownership boundaries, and complete live upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history connects this owner most strongly to the canonical shared-state database and the affected Gateway and subagent ownership surfaces.
